bio.text: The Division of Farrer is an Australian electoral division in the state of New South Wales. Located in the southwestern part of the state bordering both South Australia and Victoria, at 126,563 km2 it is the second-largest division by land area in the state after the neighbouring Division of Parkes. It includes the cities of Albury and Griffith, and has always included Albury since the creation of the division in 1949.
